activities.text: Ran the schedule audit before the house woke up — Criminal Law 09:00-10:30 and Indigenous Legal Traditions 13:30-15:00, both in person at PACI, and moved the Synergy North Nov 11 bill check to 18:15 so it stops stacking on the Angie arrival prep check

Delivered the 07:30 morning briefing — classes, the Indigenous Law readings due today, and the two Home jobs waiting after class: fix Rheia's dollhouse and wash both kids' bedding before the family arrives Nov 13
Recording the morning Drive-Time Prep for Criminal Law and writing this house's plan for the day — a full Thunder Bay school day, Ottawa mode off

Gap block after Criminal Law: drafting the LAWS 1530 Response Paper on the Marlene Pierre / Indian agents angle — first job is pulling real pinpoint lines from Joseph and the TRC, no invented cites — plus today's Indigenous Law readings on the clan system, Beaver Gives a Feast, Basil Johnston on leadership, and Borrows on the pow wow decision
Noon dinner check-in — no dinner plan logged yet this morning, so this is where today's gets picked
Second car-start at 13:00, out by 13:10 and back to PACI for the afternoon block
Home after class for the arrival-prep jobs due today: fixing Rheia's dollhouse first while there's still light and patience for tiny screws
Washing both kids' full bedding so it's clean and ready before Angie, Rheia and Elijah arrive Nov 13
Evening wrap around 21:00 — rewrite this house to the day as it actually happened and close out the journal
